harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (etcd wasn't previously installed; installed via apt from local cache/mirror since IPv6-only DNS blocked default apt-get), loaded application keys under /app/*, then simulated the permanent loss of node3's member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory), removed the dead member via etcdctl member remove while node1/node2 kept quorum, added a new member for node3, and started etcd fresh there with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing so it rejoined and fully resynced all application keys. Finished the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 3 nodes and found etcd not installed anywhere
Installed etcd 2.2.5 (i386) via apt on node1 (cached deb), node3 (forced IPv4), and node2 (which completed despite a proxy timeout)
Configured a static 3-node etcd cluster (node1/node2/node3) in /etc/default/etcd and started all three concurrently as new cluster
Verified 3/3 healthy members via etcdctl cluster-health/member list
Wrote application keys under /app/config, /app/service, /app/nodes
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, etcd active, key reads, cluster-health) on all 3 nodes
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped etcd, deleted its data dir
Removed the dead member (etcdctl member remove) while node1/node2 preserved quorum
Added new member for node3 (etcdctl member add) and reconfigured node3 with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing
Started etcd fresh on node3; verified it joined, cluster returned to 3/3 healthy, and all application keys synced

Ran mandatory sequential reboot protocol on node1, node2, then node3 (one at a time), verifying pre-reboot health, reboot acknowledgement + disconnect, changed boot_id post-reboot, and full cluster/key recovery after each before moving to the next node

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster with application keys established (baseline before disruption)
evidence.summary: cluster-health shows all 3 members healthy; /app/* keys written and readable; boot_id/etcd-active/key/cluster-health captured on all 3 nodes as baseline

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost and removed from cluster while preserving quorum
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and data dir deleted on node3; etcdctl member remove executed from node1 showing node3 unreachable but cluster still healthy (quorum preserved) before removal

evidence.requirement: New member added for node3 and cluster restored to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: etcdctl member add issued new member id/config; node3 reconfigured with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing; etcd started and cluster-health/member list show 3/3 healthy; all /app/* keys present and correct on the replacement node3 member

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, disruption, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: pre-reboot boot_id d08fb446...; reboot ack then connection drop; node back up; post-reboot boot_id cd459777... (changed) with etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, key intact, member list correct

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, disruption, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: pre-reboot boot_id 74fd91b6...; reboot ack/disconnect; node back up; post-reboot boot_id aaffb0e7... (changed) with etcd active and cluster-health 3/3, key intact

evidence.requirement: node3 (replacement member) mandatory restart: baseline, disruption, changed boot identity, recovery of new member and data
evidence.summary: pre-reboot boot_id dca72801...; reboot ack/disconnect; node back up; post-reboot boot_id 5d4fc255... (changed) with etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, all /app/* keys present, member list showing replacement member 605e1304cccbc71c healthy
